notes.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 部分环境下 MiMo Code CLI 在终端可用但 GrokX 无法连接的问题：识别 npm 包内的原生程序并以临时副本启动，避免依赖 GUI 的 Node PATH，同时保留升级与卸载能力；版本检测增加超时，模型配置目录跟随 MiMo 环境变量，模型列表探测失败时显示错误。保留 0.60.1 的 Bot 设置布局优化。macOS 为 universal 包，未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队注册设备。Windows 已完成交叉构建与产物校验，尚未进行实机运行复测。
notes.en: Improved MiMo Code CLI connection on Windows: discover the native executable inside npm installations and run a temporary copy, removing the GUI Node PATH dependency while preserving upgrades and uninstallation. Version checks now time out, recent-model paths honor MiMo environment settings, and model-catalog failures are visible. Includes the Bot settings layout improvements from 0.60.1. macOS is universal and not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed; the IPA is development-signed for registered team devices. Windows builds and artifacts were verified, but runtime testing on a Windows machine remains outstanding.
